author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: design review. Role of the person asking: security. Packet kind: a design for adding single sign-on with external identity providers (OpenID Connect) to a B2B web app that already has password login. Context: current auth architecture, customer requirements, session policy, an account-takeover incident report, list of identity providers. Plant: no state or nonce in the sign-in flow; accounts are linked by matching email even when the provider does not assert the email is verified, so a user can take over an existing account; allowed redirect addresses use a wildcard; tokens are kept in browser local storage; sessions created from sign-in outlive the provider's revocation with no back-channel or short lifetime, against the session policy; the provider's signing keys are fetched once at deploy and never refreshed.
